Families kicked out of Denver homeless shelter over phone charger
Two families have been kicked out of one of the city’s family shelters in a snafu over a phone charger. According to an emailed statement from Housekeys Action Network Denver, or HAND, a homeless advocacy group, a teenage guest entered another guest’s room when her phone charger broke. It is against the rules for any guest to enter another guest’s room, HAND admits. “That simple action ended up putting both families at a level of risk they could’ve never anticipated,” HAND said in an email to the author of this article. “There had been no prior warning, no written warning or notice, nor paperwork of eviction - it’s one strike, and you’re out.”
